rule: Frozen before any ot9 training run. A changed seed, bar value or baseline pin is a new experiment, not a revision of this one; cli/tests/test_ot9_contract.py is the freeze.

baseline.lineage: an independent mechanical copy of ot7-robin-c (docs/probes/ot8/baselines.json); ot8 dispatched no product turn on it and accepted nothing
baseline.access: read-only; every ot9 project is a new ot9-* copy
baseline.geometry_digest_method: CadexGeometryDigest.staged_geometry_digest over the accepted attempt's result.json and outputs/, under build/release/bin/FreeCADCmd; identical in two processes
baseline.stale_learned_geometry: script.json accepted_geometry carries geometry_digest 4c75ff53... keyed on accepted_digest 0a6fe0f5..., which is not this project's accepted digest; it is stale and is not the pin

bar.tilt_reference: comp_chassis attitude in the accepted solved pose, before reset variation
bar.aggregation: every seed must pass; one failed seed fails the candidate

seed_rule: The ten values the baseline script's own rollout_seed parameter admits (num 0..9, step 1, script.py line 24), so every evaluation runs through the design's declared assembly.rollout(pol, seed=int(p.rollout_seed)) and the engine's own rollout_policy. Fixed before any training and before any seed's reset draw was computed; never re-chosen, extended or subset, and held across design revisions even if a revision changes that parameter's range. Trainer --seed values are a separate random stream (the trainer's own PRNG, not the engine's random.Random(seed) reset draws) and are recorded separately.
